summary: The agent failed the test suite despite extensive self-verification. The trace shows the agent was confident in its output but never actually ran the official test file (test_output.py). The agent relied on custom verification scripts that checked approximate patterns rather than exact test expectations. Key gaps: (1) agent never parsed the actual test file to extract exact requirements, (2) self-built verification passed while official tests failed, (3) no incremental pytest execution was performed. The existing excel-financial-modeling skill needs strengthening with explicit guidance to parse test files first and run pytest incrementally, not just custom verification.
